title: Increased HTTP 5xx Errors in Bangkok, Thailand region
summary: Cloudflare is investigating an increased level of HTTP 5xx errors in Bangkok, Thailand region (BKK). We are working to analyse and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
